title: Choose the visual world
question: Frutiger Aero is pinned. The roll picked which corner of that world to build. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Clear Water, Open Sky
options.lineage: 2006-2010 eco-tech screensavers and ads: sky, water, bubbles, glass
options.thesis: Every clutch surfaces like a bubble from clear water; you read it through the glass before it breaks.
options.viewport: Bright sky meeting water; the clip floats in a thick glass pane, and at the freeze the players rise as glass bubbles holding their HP, gun and utility, with two gel orbs: green Clutch, orange Choke.
options.risk: Reads as a Windows wallpaper costume if the bubbles are decoration instead of the data.

raised.raise: The situation card reads in one fixed cross-check order: clock, bomb, clutcher, then each opponent, every bubble the same anatomy.
One enormous glossy 1v2 numeral carries the hierarchy at the freeze; everything else is small.
The upload pipeline shows its structure: every step and every clip's state visible as bubbles rising, nothing behind a spinner.

options.label: Console Blades
options.thesis: The game as a glossy console dashboard: Play, Upload and Results are blades you slide between.
options.viewport: Three stacked translucent blades; the front blade holds the clip and the call, the others peek from the side.
options.risk: The most familiar gaming corner of Aero; also where most runs for a game would land.

options.label: Night Flight Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six luminous gauges cross-checked in a fixed sweep.
options.viewport: Clutch state as a six-gauge panel.
options.risk: Fights the pinned Aero brief head on.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark instrument panel contradicts the pinned Frutiger Aero world.
options.kept: A fixed cross-check reading order for the situation card.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.viewport: One giant glyph and a live axis readout.
options.risk: Austere flatness is the opposite of Aero gloss.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience link to CS or to the pinned era.
options.kept: One enormous numeral owns the freeze.

options.label: Exposed Coptic Binding
options.risk: Craft-paper warmth contradicts the pinned brief.
options.case: Fuses poorly: handmade book has no tie to the game or the era.
options.kept: The pipeline shows its structure instead of hiding it.

options.label: Salt-Stiffened Treasure Map
options.viewport: The round as a map of clues.
options.risk: Parchment directly contradicts the pinned world.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loses both audience and clarity against the pinned Aero brief.
options.kept: The card is read as clues toward a call.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark esports stats overlay: black, neon accent, data tiles.
canonCard.viewport: Video top, stat tiles below, two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Ignores the pinned Frutiger Aero brief.
